topic: Front Right Door Ambient Lamp Brightness and Breathing Control Commands
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or configuration parameter for the front right door ambient lamp, including color, brightness, and breathing rate.
column_semantics: The columns define the input source (e.g., LIN bus), the controller/module involved (e.g., RHZCU, DoorAmbtLampF_FR), and the system subcomponent (e.g., DoorFR6LampBrtnsCmd_1 for brightness commands).

core_entities.name: DoorFR6LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the brightness of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFR6LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the breathing rate of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Right Hand Zone Central Unit, responsible for processing and executing lighting commands.

core_entities.name: DoorAmbtLampF_FR
core_entities.description: Front Right Door Ambient Lamp module, which receives commands and controls the physical lamp.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network bus used for communication between controllers and modules.

core_conditions.name: Color Command
core_conditions.description: 0x00 = No Request; 0x01-0xFF = Various color values. The lamp switches to the color corresponding to the RGB coordinate.

core_conditions.name: Brightness Command
core_conditions.description: 0x00 = No Request; 0x00 = No Request; 0x65-0xFF = Reserved. The brightness is adjusted to a percentage value.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate Command
core_conditions.description: 0x0-0xF = Various rates from Rate0 (No Request) to Rate15. Each rate corresponds to a specific breathing pattern.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Color Output
core_outputs.description: The actual color displayed by the ambient lamp based on the received color command.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Brightness Output
core_outputs.description: The actual brightness level of the ambient lamp based on the received brightness command.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Breathing Output
core_outputs.description: The breathing pattern (on/off cycle) of the ambient lamp based on the received breathing rate command.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate0
core_timing_constraints.description: No timing constraint applied when no request is made.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the command structure and parameter ranges for controlling the front right door ambient lamp's color, brightness, and breathing rate. It is used to verify that the lamp responds correctly to various commands sent via the LIN bus to the RHZCU, which then forwards them to the DoorAmbtLampF_FR module.
